back.accessibility_label: Back to the conversation with Mei, 2 waiting for you in Friends

verification.label: Verified: you compared codes on 3 Oct

auto_accept.title: Accept files from Mei automatically
auto_accept.body: Files from Mei download without asking. They’re saved where other received files go and never open by themselves.

actions.label: Delete chat history…
actions.note: Clears this chat on all your computers. Mei stays your friend.

confirm.title: Delete your chat history with Mei?
confirm.body: Your messages and file history with Mei are deleted from this computer, and from your other computers as soon as they connect. Anything still waiting to go to Mei won’t be sent. Mei stays your friend and keeps their own copy of the chat. Files you received stay where they were saved.

actions.label: Remove friend
actions.note: Takes Mei off your list. Mei can send you a new request.

confirm.title: Remove Mei?
confirm.body: Mei leaves your list and isn’t told. Anything still waiting to go to Mei won’t be sent. Your chat history with Mei is kept unless you also delete it.

actions.label: Block Mei
actions.note: Mei can’t reach you or send requests until you unblock.
